entries.title: Psalms 96:1
segments: ¶Oh, sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:2
segments: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.

entries.title: Psalms 96:3
segments: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
segments: For the LORD [is] great and greatly to be praised; He [is] to be feared above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 96:5
segments: For all the gods of the peoples [are] idols, But the LORD made the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 96:6
segments: Honor and majesty [are] before Him; Strength and beauty [are] in His sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 96:7
segments: Give to the LORD, O families of the peoples, Give to the LORD glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 96:8
segments: Give to the LORD the glory [due] His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
segments: Oh, worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness! Tremble before Him, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
segments: ¶Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns; The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved; He shall judge the peoples righteously."

entries.title: Psalms 96:11
segments: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; Let the sea roar, and all its fullness;

entries.title: Psalms 96:12
segments: Let the field be joyful, and all that [is] in it. Then all the trees of the woods will rejoice

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
segments: before the LORD. (96:13) For He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth. He shall judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with His truth.
